outcomes.name: Understanding of the stakeholder engagement approach has been assessed across all live sites/teams
The stakeholder engagement approach is consistently applied everywhere the change has gone live

actions.action: Recognise that People Experience & Culture is inconsistent across teams/sites since go-live and gather evidence of where the gaps are in the stakeholder engagement approach.
Identify why the stakeholder engagement approach hasn't landed consistently for People Experience & Culture in specific teams/sites and agree a plan to address it.
Re-engage leaders in lagging teams/sites to re-establish the stakeholder engagement approach for People Experience & Culture.
Confirm the stakeholder engagement approach for People Experience & Culture is being applied consistently across previously inconsistent areas.
Monitor People Experience & Culture regularly to ensure the stakeholder engagement approach stays consistently reinforced everywhere.
Survey teams/sites to understand how Strategic Direction & Leadership has been affected by inconsistent stakeholder engagement approach since go-live.
Develop a targeted plan to address the specific Strategic Direction & Leadership-related gaps identified in lagging areas.
Deliver targeted support to strengthen Strategic Direction & Leadership in teams/sites where the stakeholder engagement approach is weakest.
Confirm Strategic Direction & Leadership has improved in previously lagging teams/sites.
Embed regular pulse-checks on Strategic Direction & Leadership so gaps in the stakeholder engagement approach are caught early in future.
